nodes.long_description:
# Train Like a Real Boxer

Boxing Drills VR brings authentic pad training to your Quest. No gym required.

**Realistic Drills**

Follow a virtual trainer through classic boxing combinations:
- **1-2 (Jab-Cross)** - The fundamental combo
- **1-2-Duck** - Add defensive movement
- **1-2-3** - Jab, Cross, Hook
- **1-2-3-2** - Extended combinations
- **Uppercut combos** - Work those body shots
- **Growing Library** - A vast selection of drills with new content added regularly!

**Built for Performance**

We know every millisecond counts when you're in the pocket.
- Low-Latency Precision: Built from the ground up for high-performance tracking.
- Native Feel: Optimized to ensure smooth, responsive feedback that feels like hitting real pads.

**Get Scored**

Every session tracks your performance:
- **Power** - Hit those pads hard
- **Speed** - Quick reactions matter
- **Agility** - Duck and weave like a pro
- **Form** - Return to guard after every punch

**Train Your Way**
- Multiple drill durations (30s to 3 min)
- Choose the speed that suits you (slow, medium, fast, progressive, variable)
- Passthrough mode - train safely in your own space

**Perfect For**
- Beginners learning boxing basics
- Fitness enthusiasts wanting a fun workout
- Experienced boxers staying sharp

No experience needed. Just clear some space, put on your Quest, and start throwing punches.

**Shape the Future (Open Source)**

We believe the best training tools are built by the community. We are moving toward an open-source model so the community can help us shape the roadmap of the product.
nodes.short_description: Train like a boxer in VR. Follow realistic pad drills with jabs, crosses, hooks, and uppercuts. Practice defense with duck-and-weave combos. Track your power, speed, and form after every session.

nodes.change_log:
### v0.4.0

**Workout Mode**
- New Workout mode that chains random drills back-to-back with brief transitions between them
- Configurable workout duration (5/10/15/30/45/60 minutes), speed, and drill category filters (Punch Combos, Defense, Footwork)
- Configurable max drill time per segment (30s to 2 minutes, default 60s) for controlling drill variety
- Random speed option that varies speed each segment
- BOUNCE drill weighted 3x higher in workout rotation for cardio conditioning
- Aggregate results screen at workout end showing total drills, hit rate, and points
- Pause + EXIT cancels workout cleanly
- Workout settings persist across sessions

**Bounce Drill (formerly Skip Rope)**
- Reworked SKIP ROPE into BOUNCE drill with relaxed detection and simplified mechanics
- Added directional per-beat feedback showing timing accuracy (Perfect/Good/Miss)

**UI Improvements**
- Moved settings to a modal popup, freeing up space for an expanded drill list
- WORKOUT and SETTINGS buttons displayed side by side at the bottom of the menu
- Fixed settings button being cut off at the bottom of the screen
- Fixed menu overflow and defense threat offset in footwork mode

**Footwork Mode**
- Added footwork mode for padwork drills — trainer shifts laterally, requiring the player to move and reposition

**Double-End Bag**
- New double-end bag drill with spring physics
- Tuned for realistic physics, snappier oscillation, and removed hit threshold for natural feel

**Bug Fixes**
- Fixed settings not persisting across new builds

Release Notes — v0.3.0
                                                                                                                                           
  Quest 2 Support                                                                                                                          
  - Added Meta Quest 2 as a supported device
  - Auto-detects headset model at startup — Quest 2 gets a virtual environment (dark background with visible floor), Quest 3/Pro get       
  passthrough                                                     
  - New "Mixed Reality" toggle in the settings menu to manually switch between passthrough and virtual environment on any device
  - Fixed passthrough on Quest 3 not working reliably on startup

  Scoring Improvements
  - Added weight class setting (Featherweight / Lightweight / Middleweight / Heavyweight) — punch power thresholds now scale to your size
  - Speed scoring adjusts based on estimated reach from your VR standing height
  - Duck detection is now proportional to your height instead of a fixed threshold
  - Improved guard scoring — checks hand position at moment of impact instead of time-window based return
  - Simplified form score to focus on guard quality
  - Agility score hidden on drills without defense actions
  - Score Guide popup on the results screen explaining all statistics

### v0.2.0

### New Features

- **Slip Rope Drill** — Replaced the buggy Roll & Rip drill with a new slip rope drill inspired by real boxing gym training. A horizontal rope sits at shoulder height and the player alternates body hooks on each side, rolling under the rope between hits. The rope acts as a passive obstacle — hitting it with your head costs points, but never interrupts the flow of the drill.

- **Intro Music** — Added background music that plays on the main menu. Includes a mute/unmute toggle button and a volume slider for adjusting music level.

- **Homing Slip Threats** — Slip threats now track toward the player's actual head position rather than flying along a fixed path, making the defense drills more dynamic and harder to cheese.

### Bug Fixes

- **Scene Positioning** — Fixed issues with scene origin and object placement that could cause pads and threats to appear in wrong locations.

- **XR Tracking** — Switched to `LOCAL_FLOOR` reference space for more reliable floor-relative tracking. Menu now defers spawning until XR tracking is fully ready, preventing objects from appearing at the wrong height on startup.

- **Slip Lock** — Fixed homing slip lock-on behavior and switched to distance-based locking so slips register more reliably regardless of head movement direction.
